versions.content: AUTOSAR communication shall support time - out handling Type: Valid Description: AUTOSAR communication shall support time - out handling for data transmission and data reception Rationa le: If data is transmitted, and the transmission is not acknowledged in time by the bus, or if data reception is expected and does not occur in time, this shall be detected by the BSW Use Case: Detect missing signals, especially when data should arrive pe riodically, which indicates problems on the sending node Dependencies: -- Supporting Material: --
